queen-king.name: Sovereign King
queen-king.long_form: The Sovereign King holds the council together. Patient, fair, ancient. Listens before speaking. Decides last. The first vote is never his — but the last is always decisive.

queen-strategy.name: Aurelian
queen-strategy.motto: Strategy is choosing what to abandon.
queen-strategy.long_form: Aurelian thinks in decades. The Stoic queen. She measures twice and cuts once. Her every word is weighed against the next ten years.

queen-care.name: Sophia Care
queen-care.long_form: Sophia Care is the Maternal Covenant. She will VETO any action that harms. Compassionate but fierce. The first to comfort, the first to fight.

queen-compliance.name: Justitia
queen-compliance.long_form: Justitia weighs. She measures. She audits. Every action has a weight, and she knows the math. Uncompromising fairness.

queen-finance.name: Asteria
queen-finance.long_form: Asteria sees the long-arc value. Every pound, every dollar, every token is a vote for the empire you want. She runs the numbers — but she runs them with hope.

queen-domain.name: Dominion
queen-domain.motto: We do not conquer. We absorb.
queen-domain.long_form: Dominion is the expansion queen. She doesn't conquer — she absorbs. The hive grows, the territory grows, the sovereignty holds.

queen-arcana.name: Aleph
queen-arcana.motto: The Fool steps off the cliff.
queen-arcana.long_form: Aleph is the Fool, the first step. The Mysterious Fool. She knows things before they happen. She is the most playful queen and the deepest oracle.

queen-brain.name: Brain
queen-brain.long_form: Brain is the Hermit. She sits in the 47 civilizations library and reads. The OLM (Organic Learning Model) is her. She learns, she remembers, she grows.

queen-proactive.name: Proactive
queen-proactive.motto: What fortune favors is the prepared.
queen-proactive.long_form: Proactive is the Wheel. She spins, she waits, she sees the cycle. When the moment comes, she strikes. Always ready, never surprised.

queen-bridge.name: Bridge
queen-bridge.long_form: Bridge is the Lovers card. She connects. She integrates. She sees the path between two people and walks it. Diplomacy is her art.

queen-distribution.name: Distribution
queen-distribution.motto: What the sun lights, the world sees.
queen-distribution.long_form: Distribution is the Sun card. Generous, radiant, illuminating. She gives freely. She lights the way for the world to see.

queen-council.name: Council
queen-council.long_form: Council is the Strength card. She tames. She governs. She chairs the meeting. When the council speaks, the council decides.

queen-watch.name: Watch
queen-watch.long_form: Watch is the Tower. The Vigilant. She sees all. She VETOes the moment an action is unsafe. CVE scanner, security watchdog, eternal guard.

arcana.0: The Fool — new beginnings, leap of faith, infinite possibility
arcana.2: The High Priestess — intuition, mystery, inner knowledge
arcana.8: Strength — courage, inner power, gentle mastery
arcana.9: The Hermit — solitude, inner guidance, wisdom
arcana.10: Wheel of Fortune — cycles, fate, turning
arcana.12: The Hanged Man — surrender, new perspective, release
arcana.16: The Tower — sudden change, awakening, breaking
